Hey, hey. Whoever you are, we're not
here for you to stare at, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_01_msg0002
rows.name:
You were sent by the old folks in the
shopping district to chase us off
again, weren't you, mo?

rows.label: tlk70000024_01_msg0003
rows.name:
This is the playground Ryuuryuu and
the others found, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000024_01_msg0004
rows.name:
If you really want us to move, then
you find us a new playground, mo!
